content: Lookbook/gallery layouts: stacked single-column scroll is best for mobile-first fashion lookbooks (Instagram-trained users, natural scroll); grid suits desktop with lightbox on click; phone grids collapse to one column. Ciena collection pages use CSS grid gallery with variable spans + custom lightbox (prev/next/close, click outside to close, keyboard support) and a Voltar (back) link. Consistent aspect ratios simplify lightbox logic; keyboard and touch parity recommended; native dialog + CSS scroll-snap is a modern zero-dependency lightbox approach.
